request.style: English, male folk voice, solo, acoustic guitar, banjo, soft percussion, warm mood, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Jesus entered Jericho
Walking down the street
A rich man named Zacchaeus
Chief collector of the fee
He was short and crowded out
Could not see the face
So he ran ahead in haste
To find a better place

[Chorus]
Zacchaeus hurry down
Stay at your house today
Salvation has come to this house
Son of Abraham now

[Verse]
He climbed a sycamore tree
To watch Him pass by
But Jesus looked up and spoke
With a gentle eye
He welcomed Him with joy
While the crowd grumbled loud
Saying He went to stay
With a sinful man about

[Chorus]
Zacchaeus hurry down
Stay at your house today
Salvation has come to this house
Son of Abraham now

[Bridge]
I give half to the poor
All that I possess
I pay back four times over
Every loss I confess

[Outro]
The Son of Man came to seek
To save what was lost
